components.label: Background
components.description: Animated brand background (shader) or a solid colour

shader.label: Look
shader.help: mesh · silk · metal · aurora · rays · contour

components.label: Full-frame picture
components.description: A photo filling the frame, with zoom, drift, grade and vignette

components.label: Picture card
components.description: A photo on a printed card that lands in the frame

components.label: Video clip
components.description: A video clip filling the frame, optionally graded

components.label: Title
components.description: A heading with an entrance effect

effect.label: Effect
effect.help: rotate: words separated by | take turns in one slot

components.label: Captions
components.description: Word-timed captions from the voiceover or from text, in any caption preset

source.label: Words from
source.help: voice: the project voiceover’s word timings (falls back to the text until there is a voice) · text: spread the text below evenly

layout.description: line: words flow on 1–2 lines · stack: lead / big hero / tail · word: one word at a time

pauseBreak.description: a gap longer than this (s) starts a new page

y.description: vertical centre of the caption, 0 = top

autoHero.description: no hero marked? use the longest word of each page

components.label: Figures
components.description: 2–4 numbers ticking in, with unit and label

components.label: Callout
components.description: A point on the picture, a leader line and a label chip

components.label: Distance rings
components.description: Rings opening from the site, each with a label

components.label: Route
components.description: A route that draws itself to a pinned destination

components.label: Depth reveal
components.description: A photo that builds in near → far from its depth map

components.label: Light leak
components.description: A brand-tinted light leak across the frame (once per film)

components.label: Vignette
components.description: Soft edge darkening

components.label: Logo reveal
components.description: The brand mark revealed in metal or as is

mode.label: Finish
mode.help: brand: the theme decides · mask: repaint in metal · image: as is

components.label: Two-weight heading
components.description: Light words and accent words landing one by one

components.label: Place line
components.description: A small tracked place name under a light rule

components.label: Number ticker
components.description: One big number rolling into place

components.label: Checklist
components.description: A card of items, each ticked on its cue

components.label: Toggle pills
components.description: 2–4 benefits switching on, one by one

components.label: Carousel
components.description: Cards advancing one picture at a time

components.label: Side-by-side cards
components.description: Two picture cards, the second landing on its cue

components.label: Word behind subject
components.description: A word placed between the picture and its cut-out subject

components.label: Magnifier
components.description: A loupe gliding over a picture, magnified inside

showPicture.label: Show the picture
showPicture.help: off: only the loupe, over a picture on a track below (same box)

components.label: Spotlight
components.description: A soft cone of light sweeping once across the frame

components.label: Beam
components.description: A curved line drawing between two points, then a light running it

components.label: Shape morph
components.description: One outline becoming the next (pin → building → home)

components.label: Architect grid
components.description: A faint drifting architectural grid over the background

components.label: Wireframe eye
components.description: A wireframe eye that traces in and blinks, behind "vision" lines

components.label: Wireframe pin
components.description: A wireframe map pin over a ground grid

components.label: Call to action
components.description: Wordmark and a button that gets pressed on its cue

components.label: End wordmark
components.description: The wordmark alone, large, with one gleam
